holdout_policy.rule: prospective/ never opened, never cited, never generated

multiplicity_policy.feasibility_rule: n_boot + 1 >= 20 * m AND n_flips + 1 >= 20 * m for every declared family; otherwise freeze blocked (fail-closed)
multiplicity_policy.mc_resolution_note: At M=1000 the minimum representable p is 1/1001; at Holm's first threshold a member must produce the minimum representable p to survive for m in 36-50, and borderline members are resolved with 25-48% probability, always biased toward non-rejection. Disclosed in the campaign-end record note.
multiplicity_policy.missing_member_effect: Counting an unavailable member toward m at p=1.0 STRICTENS, never loosens, the remaining members' Holm thresholds (corrected wording; the pinned decision sheet's 'thresholds are unchanged' is wrong -- see D2_REVIEW_SUPERSESSION_NOTE_2026_10_13.md item 1).
multiplicity_policy.n_flips_note: M = the week-level sign-flip count. The recorded feasibility must include M: the p-value's resolution is 1/(M+1), so a formal refutation at Holm's first threshold alpha/m is attainable only while M + 1 >= 20*m. feasibility() now enforces both counts and treats a missing M as infeasible (never silently feasible).
multiplicity_policy.p_value_note: Writing Holm machinery into a config does not adopt method (b). The p-value method stays UNRESOLVED until the owner records D2; the campaign-end record gate refuses to compute adjusted p-values until then. Validity, once adopted, is procedure-level (marginal over the recorded flip draw), never conditional on the realized flip set (D2 review + Addendum A, 2026-10-13).
